title: Settings
autonomy: Default autonomy level for new threads
autonomyHint: Autonomous execution within project scope; writes outside the project are still sandboxed and rollbackable.
toolDensityHint: Controls read/search tool group collapse: compact (always collapsed), balanced (collapsed, expandable), detailed (expanded).
wallpaperHint: Setting a wallpaper activates translucent frosted glass (similar to macOS vibrancy). Stored locally only.
